::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Planned, from the syllabus"}
Delete this block once the lesson is drafted.

> - Hold pitch and synth constant. Vary attack, decay, sustain, release.
> - A slow attack turns a piano into a string section. A short release turns a pad into a percussion hit.
> - Envelope is how you will encode staccato, legato, and accent later, so build the vocabulary now.
>
> **Checkpoint: given a recorded note, you can guess its rough envelope shape and reproduce it.**
:::
